description: This file defines the TalkOverlayController class responsible for managing the presentation and state of a talk overlay UI in a macOS application. It includes methods for showing, dismissing, and updating the overlay, along with private functions for window management.

classes.name: TalkOverlayController
classes.description: Final class that manages the overlay's UI presentation, visibility, and interaction within a macOS environment.

classes.name: TalkOverlayHostingView
classes.description: A custom NSHostingView subclass that accepts first mouse events, used for hosting the overlay view.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Sets up and displays the overlay window with the current model state.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Hides and removes the overlay window.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the current interaction phase of the overlay, logging the change.

methods.name: updatePaused
methods.description: Updates the paused state of the overlay, logging the change.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Adjusts the overlay's level indicator, constrained between 0 and 1.

methods.name: currentWindowOrigin
methods.description: Returns the current origin point of the overlay window.

methods.name: setWindowOrigin
methods.description: Sets the position of the overlay window based on a CGPoint.
